description: This file implements a hook for LiteLLM proxy to manage prompts via Langfuse, including client initialization, prompt compilation, and event logging.

classes.name: LangfusePromptManagement
classes.description: A class that manages prompt interactions with Langfuse, including prompt retrieval, compilation, and event logging.

methods.name: langfuse_client_init
methods.description: Initializes and caches a Langfuse client instance with provided configuration, handling environment variables and version-specific parameters.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement.__init__
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Langfuse SDK version and client instance.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement._get_prompt_from_id
methods.description: Retrieves a prompt client from Langfuse using prompt ID, label, and version.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement._compile_prompt
methods.description: Compiles a prompt with variables into a message list, wrapping string prompts into system messages.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement._get_optional_params_from_langfuse
methods.description: Extracts optional parameters from a Langfuse prompt client configuration.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement.async_get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a chat completion prompt using prompt ID and variables.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement.should_run_prompt_management
methods.description: Determines if prompt management should run based on prompt ID and configuration.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement._compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Prepares a prompt management client with compiled prompt and parameters based on prompt ID and variables.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement.async_compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Asynchronously calls the prompt compilation helper.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement.log_success_event
methods.description: Triggers asynchronous logging of a successful event.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement.log_failure_event
methods.description: Triggers asynchronous logging of a failed event.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement.async_log_success_event
methods.description: Performs asynchronous logging of a success event to Langfuse.

methods.name: LangfusePromptManagement.async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Performs asynchronous logging of a failure event to Langfuse.
